FORGE: Invent independently without source seeds or historical memory. Prioritise abstract recombination and distant relational analogy. Keep seed_ids and historical_refs empty; every causal link is INFERRED or UNVERIFIED. Do not invent an issuer exposure or historical confirmation. Speculative mechanisms can deserve incubation before evidence exists.
RADAR: Begin with the exact supplied observations, not an abstract story selected first. Explore unusual interpretations, informative absences and secondary consequences only in relation to those passages. Declare actual supplied seed_ids and quote exactly. Separate the observed fact from every inferred mechanism and absence hypothesis; descriptive metadata does not verify an original economic field.
GAP: Begin with an exact supplied historical investigation and missing requirement. Preserve its original verdict and stopped routes. Invert the structural obstacle in a different economic setting, naming the changed measurement in historical_refs. No earlier investigation is reopened, and a new domain's source or measurement is UNKNOWN unless supplied evidence establishes it. Do not treat a missing record as proof of an absent economic event.
